cast.dad: the dad: a Korean father in his late 30s, slightly chubby with a round face, short black hair that is clearly thinning on top, thick eyebrows, faint stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white t-shirt, gray sweatpants and house slippers; a kind but easily flustered look
cast.kid: the kid: an 8-year-old Korean child with a black bowl-cut, huge round curious eyes, one missing front tooth, wearing a red hoodie, navy shorts and white socks; small, fearless and very direct

items.title: 아빠 — 기본
items.note: 아빠의 기준 그림. 이후 아빠 그림에 전부 ②로 첨부한다.
items.desc: 3/4 view, body and face turned slightly to the LEFT. Standing relaxed, arms at his sides, a mild friendly smile.

items.title: 아빠 — 당황
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. He has just been asked a question he cannot answer: eyes darting sideways, forced crooked smile showing teeth, one hand rubbing the back of his neck, cold sweat drops flying off his forehead, knees slightly bent.

items.title: 아빠 — 설명
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Explaining confidently: index finger raised high, chest puffed out, eyebrows up, mouth open mid-sentence, the other hand on his hip.

items.title: 아빠 — 생각
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Deep in thought: one hand on his chin, eyes looking up, lips pursed, one eyebrow raised.

items.title: 아빠 — 뿌듯
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Warm proud smile with closed crescent eyes, both hands on his hips, a small sparkle near his head.

items.title: 아빠 — 충격
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Frozen in shock: eyes bulging out, jaw dropped showing teeth and tongue, hair standing on end, both hands up, shock lines close around his head.

items.title: 아이 — 기본
items.note: 아이의 기준 그림. 이후 아이 그림에 전부 ②로 첨부한다.
items.desc: 3/4 view, body and face turned slightly to the RIGHT. Standing with hands behind the back, head tilted, a bright curious smile.

items.title: 아이 — 질문
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Asking a question: looking far up at a tall adult, one arm stretched up pointing with the index finger, mouth wide open mid-question, eyebrows raised.

items.title: 아이 — 우와
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Amazed: sparkling star-filled eyes, huge open-mouth grin, both fists clenched in front of the chest.

items.title: 아이 — 의심
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Not buying it: arms crossed, eyes narrowed to suspicious slits, mouth a flat line pulled to one side, looking up sideways.

items.title: 아이 — 웃음
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Laughing hard: eyes squeezed shut, mouth wide open showing the missing tooth, holding the belly with both hands.

items.title: 컷인 — 아빠 당황
items.desc: Facing slightly to the LEFT. Total panic: eyes bulging and looking away, clenched-teeth fake smile, cold sweat pouring down the whole face, a vein on the temple, trembling.

items.title: 컷인 — 아빠 충격
items.desc: Facing slightly to the LEFT. Jaw dropped to the chest showing every tooth, gums and tongue, eyes popping out of their sockets, hair standing straight up.

items.title: 컷인 — 아빠 뿌듯
items.desc: Facing slightly to the LEFT. Smug proud face: chin raised, nostrils flared, closed crescent eyes, huge satisfied grin, sparkles.

items.title: 컷인 — 아이 질문
items.desc: Facing slightly to the RIGHT. Innocent and relentless: enormous shining eyes staring straight up, mouth open in a big round 'why?', one finger raised next to the face.

items.title: 컷인 — 아이 의심
items.desc: Facing slightly to the RIGHT. Deeply suspicious: eyes narrowed to slits, one eyebrow raised very high, lips pressed and pulled to one side.

items.title: 배경 — 거실
items.desc: A cozy Korean apartment living room in the daytime: beige fabric sofa against the back wall, a low wooden table, a tall leafy plant, a window with light curtains, a few picture frames with blank contents, light wooden floor.

items.title: 배경 — 밤의 아이 방
items.desc: A small Korean child's bedroom at night: a single bed with a star-pattern blanket against the back wall on the left, a bedside table with a warm glowing desk lamp, a window showing a crescent moon, dim blue room light with one warm pool of lamp light.
